name: 4NE-1
summary: The humanoid from Germany's NEURA Robotics, a company that builds its own actuators, sensors and 'cognitive' control stack and targets both industrial and household work. NEURA opened pre-orders and has promoted an ecosystem approach with an app store and partners; a revised 4NE-1 was shown in 2025.
notable: Leading European entrant in the general-purpose humanoid race
Vertically integrated actuators, touch sensing and AI stack
